# Edoardo Dusi

> Senior Developer Advocate at AWS, speaker, and blogger writing about the web, cloud, AI, coding and the developer ecosystem.

## Blog Posts
- [“Error while dexing”: how an Android build failure led me to a dying SSD](https://edoardodusi.com/blog/2026/error-while-dexing.html): An Android build kept failing on the same jar. Claude Code quickly traced the I/O errors to a failing NVMe SSD, then helped me verify the diagnosis and design a careful one-pass recovery.
- [Welcome to my new website and blog!](https://edoardodusi.com/blog/2026/welcome.html): I finally decided to build a proper home on the internet. Here’s a look under the hood of my new custom static site and markdown blog.
